items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that suits oily and sensitive-looking skin without stripping it.
A light ceramide moisturizer to support the skin barrier and comfort, with no actives.
A mineral SPF 50 is the most useful daily step for keeping the look of fine lines from advancing, and it is gentle on fair, sensitive skin.

response.routine_note: We have left out all retinol and retinoid products because they are best avoided during pregnancy, so please ask your prenatal care provider before adding any active, including once you are breastfeeding. Use the cleanser and moisturizer morning and night, and apply the SPF last each morning, reapplying if you are outdoors.
